$comment: Pinned sweep floors, one per gate. A gate that discovers fewer files than its floor exits non-zero: a sweep that collapses from 9,774 files to 101 verified almost nothing and must not report a pass. Floors are ~90% of the measured baseline in reports/sweep-baseline.md, so ordinary content churn does not break a build but a broken glob does. Raise a floor when the real count grows; lower one only with a written reason in the commit.
$policy: floor = round(baseline * 0.9), floor >= 1. Baselines are the size of the subject each gate ACTUALLY guards, measured with SWEEP_GUARD_REPORT=1 — not the size its name implies. Where those differ the gap is recorded in reports/sweep-baseline.md as a finding.
